name: Trilobit
description: A cyberpunk total conversion in progress.  Only monsters tagged TRILOBIT can spawn.  Cities: 10 skyscrapers, 6 plain plus 41 themed mid-rise buildings, two megacities plus villages, 12 city-square lots, an east coast and (Trilobit exe only) a highway grid.  No enemies are placed in buildings; a fixer in your starting building gives the first mission (kill Ryo Kurogane for 1000 yen).  Start types: Test Human and Test Cyborg.  Implants: implant status display item, an implant lab in every mid-rise, five random implants at start.

//: Exclusive whitelist: only monsters with the TRILOBIT category may exist.  No stock monster has it, so none spawn.  Trilobit's own enemies will add this category to their definitions.
